goal: Prevent BIP 157 light clients from disconnecting or banning nodes when requesting filters for newly connected blocks
reviewability: Nothing known that would invalidate a review now
agreement: Strong support with all architectural objections resolved
Worth handling because filter calculation is slow enough to trigger races in practice (ajtowns)
Supports handling in net_processing to avoid disconnects and message delays (mzumsande)
Resolved objections on index coupling and covering all three BIP 157 message types (sedited, mzumsande, ajtowns)

categories.name: p2p

Races occur even on standard relay, breaking interoperability with BIP 157 peers
